content:
mira: Quick check —I'm adding a CI gate that prevents `kubectl apply` of ConfigMaps unless the PR includes a `cm-owner` label. This is to avoid accidental config drift in prod. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4821

sam: what happens to emergency hotpatches? we sometimes push CM changes directly for critical toggles

mira: good q — CI will allow bypass if the commit contains `HOTPATCH: true` and there's an ops-ci run approval. snippet from the GH action:

```
if: contains(github.event.head_commit.message, 'HOTPATCH: true') == false && !contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'cm-owner')
  run: exit 1
```

jin: will this block kustomize-based overlays applied by the runtime deployer? our rollout bot does `kubectl apply -f` from the release job

mira: runtime deployer (release job) will get a token with `ops-ci` role and can auto-approve via the action. we won't block automated release jobs. this gate targets manual/rogue `kubectl apply`s from CI without label

leo: re: secret-harvest — double-check that nobody is storing secrets in CM. can we add a linter to the check for `data:` keys > 1KB or base64 patterns?

mira: added a quick grep linter step in the PR that fails if a file matches regex `(^|\n)\s*data:\s*\n` with large blob. but it's opt-in for now; we can make it mandatory after one week of rollout

ops-ci: CI Check — PR #4821: cm-owner label missing — job `cm-gate` failed (see https://ci.redwood.dev/4821)

sam: sgtm. one more: how do we handle per-model configmaps? ownership there is fuzzy because models are owned by teams, not infra

mira: plan: allow team-scoped labels like `team-<name>` as acceptable owners for per-model CMs. will add to the PR template + a small doc under infra/CONFIG_OWNER_GUIDE.md

jin: thanks — can you ping eng-runtime when this merges? we'll update the deployer to attach the `ops-ci` approval token to release jobs

mira: will do. timeline: merge tomorrow 09:00 PT, enable gate as a rollout flag for 3 days, then enforce. ping @here when flipped

sam: :thumbsup:

leo: :eyes:

mira: EDIT: uploaded the PR patch with the label check and the docs. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4821/files

deploy-bot: deploy-preview created for infra/pr-4821 on cluster staging-2

mira: thanks — leaving this open for any final concerns before merge.
